name: spacepane-store-preview-design
description: Source of the SpacePane Mac App Store app preview film (frame-stepped HTML, encoded with ffmpeg).
comment: No dependencies of its own: render.mjs loads Playwright from the node_modules of the spacepane-web repository (SPACEPANE_WEB_REPO, default ../spacepane-web beside this repository; pinned by its pnpm-lock.yaml) and calls ffmpeg and ffprobe from PATH.
